（批：* See also D 8080）

With reference to Special Branch File No. I.O. 8983 of
December 12. 1934. in which mention is made of one Serge
Bliuds, Russian Jew (Latvian?) a suspected narcotic smuggler
and his brother(M.Bliuds? the subject of this report) an
associate of narcotic dealers in Paris, I have to report
the following:-

On December 13. 1935, two persons namely Morris Bliuds
and a Mrs Lia Katz took up residence at the Embassy Hotel.
They made no declaration as to their antecedents and left
on December 16 1935 for an unknown destination.

Enquiries reveal that on the last mentioned date they
moved to the Western Mansions, No. 941 Bubbling Well Road,
where they registered themselves as having originally
travelled from Paris. They left the Western Mansions on
January 30. 1936 and apparently left the country. M. Bliuds
returned to Shanghai on board the S.S. Tsingtao Maru on
September 24. 1936 and was in possession of a Lithuanian
Passport No. W. 191. issued in Paris on July 2. 1936.
According to his Alien Declaration made to the Chinese
Authorities, he described himself as a merchant from Berlin
and intended staying in China for a period of two months.
He gave his address as the Embassy Hotel but did not register
there.

Mrs Lia Katz arrived at the Embassy Hotel on September
25. 1936 and declared herself as Polish, born January 14.
1901, in Kiev, Russia and to have travelled from Tientsin.
During her stay at the Embassy Hotel, M. Bliuds was seen to
visit her room on numerous occasions; on one of these visits
he requested the Management to exchange a G.$500.00 for him.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）
（批：Sir, Noted; with many thanks. S Pay 0.7.）

关于1934年12月12日的特科档案第 I.O. 8983 号，其中提及一名 Serge Bliuds，俄籍犹太人（拉脱维亚人？），涉嫌毒品走私，及其兄弟（M. Bliuds？即本报告对象），据称为巴黎毒品贩子的同伙，兹报告如下：-

1935年12月13日，Morris Bliuds 和 Lia Katz 夫人两人入住礼查饭店（Embassy Hotel）。他们未申报身世背景，并于1935年12月16日前往一个未知的目的地离开。

经查询显示，在上述日期，他们搬至静安寺路941号西摩公寓（Western Mansions），登记时称最初从巴黎旅行而来。他们于1936年1月30日离开西摩公寓，并显然已离境。M. Bliuds 于1936年9月24日乘“青岛丸”号轮船（S.S. Tsingtao Maru）返回上海，持有1936年7月2日在巴黎签发的立陶宛护照，号码为 W. 191。根据他向中国当局提交的外侨登记表，他自称是来自柏林的商人，打算在中国停留两个月。他提供的地址是礼查饭店，但并未在该处登记。

Lia Katz 夫人于1936年9月25日抵达礼查饭店，申报身份为波兰籍，1901年1月14日生于俄国基辅，并称从天津旅行而来。在她入住礼查饭店期间，有人多次看见 M. Bliuds 探访她的房间；在其中一次探访中，他要求管理处为他兑换一张面值500元的金币券（G.$500.00）。

（印章：副总监（犯罪股））

SECRET
MEMORANDUM ON JOHN TSOUNIAS ALIAS JANIS
YANIS ALIAS ALDAS.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. I. B. REGISTRY No. L. O. 8983 Date 12 / 12 / 22）

Aldas is identical with a Greek Janis Tsunias alias
Yanis alias John Tsounias, which latter name he invariably
employs when conducting legitimate business.

A merchant by profession, Tsounias who was born at
Samos (Greece) on January 17, 1890, arrived in Shanghai from
Europe some time in 1923.

In Shanghai Tsounias resides at No.54 Wayside Road,
cohabiting with a Mrs. P.G. Calavitis, in whose name the
house and telephone are registered. This woman is the
widow of the former notorious drug-smuggler Calavitis, who,
until his death, was a partner in the Express Ricsha Coy,
East Yuhang Road. Tsounias now acts as manager of this
organisation, representing the interests of his paramour.
With this exception, Tsounias is not known to be engaged
in any other business, apart from the smuggling of drugs,
in which capacity he has been known for years. He appears
as Serial No. 67 on the list of "Known and/or Suspected
Criminals in Shanghai" as an arms and drug smuggler.

He was formerly the Shanghai agent of John Voyatzis,
principal representative of the Eliopoulos brothers, whose
headquarters were in Tientsin. Although Tsounias has been
kept under surveillance from time to time, all endeavours
of the Police have failed to secure sufficient evidence
which would warrant court proceedings against him.

Tsounias is the owner of a Fiat m/car, licence
No. 8839, which in 1926 he purchased from one Tai Boo Yung
(戴步雲), who was the then manager of the Boo Kee & Co.,
Importers, Exporters and Commission Agents, Room No. 10,
No. 24 The Bund. This concern, it is reported, was
established by Tsounias and Tai Boo Yung for the purpose
of facilitating their smuggling operations.
page_data.zh:
机密
关于 JOHN TSOUNIAS，化名 JANIS
YANIS，化名 ALDAS 的备忘录。
（印章：上海公共租界工部局刑事侦缉处登记处 编号 L. O. 8983 日期 22/12/12）

Aldas 与希腊人 Janis Tsunias（化名 Yanis，化名 John Tsounias）为同一人，后者在进行合法生意时一贯使用此名。

Tsounias 职业为商人，1890年1月17日生于萨摩斯岛（希腊），于1923年某时从欧洲抵达上海。

在上海，Tsounias 居住在韦思德路54号，与 P.G. Calavitis 夫人同居，房屋和电话均注册在该女士名下。该女子是前著名毒品走私犯 Calavitis 的遗孀，Calavitis 生前是东余杭路快车人力车公司（Express Ricsha Coy.）的合伙人。Tsounias 目前担任该机构的经理，代表其情妇的利益。除此之外，除毒品走私外，未发现 Tsounias 从事其他任何业务，他在此方面的活动已为人所知多年。他在“上海已知及/或嫌疑罪犯名单”中列为第67号，身份为军火及毒品走私犯。

他曾任 John Voyatzis 的上海代理人，Voyatzis 是总部设在天津的 Eliopoulos 兄弟的主要代表。尽管警方不时对 Tsounias 进行监视，但至今为止，警方的一切努力均未能获得足以对其提起诉讼的证据。

Tsounias 拥有一辆菲亚特汽车，牌照号 8839，该车于1926年从戴步雲（Tai Boo Yung）处购得，戴当时是外滩24号10室的进出口及佣金代理商宝记洋行（Boo Kee & Co.）的经理。据报道，该公司由 Tsounias 和戴步雲建立，目的是便利他们的走私活动。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

It is known that Tsounias received his correspondence,
most probably addressed in the name of Aldas, through the
medium of P.O. Box No. 1511, which was rented by Messrs. Boo
Kee & Co. on October 15, 1928, a Mr. T.S. Yeh of the Chung
Foo Co., Room No. 22, No. 24 The Bund, acting as guarantor.
The latter firm was very closely connected with the former
concern and after Boo Kee & Co. closed down in the early part
of 1934, all mail matter addressed to this company was
forwarded to the Chung Foo Co.

Tai Boo Yung formerly stayed at Lane 341, House 12,
Medhurst Road, but is now living at his own newly constructed
residence on Kiangwan Road. He was at one time employed by
the Chinese Maritime Customs, later becoming associated with
Tsounias and the former China Europe Trading Coy., 128 Museum
Road, which was established by N.L. Brandstatter. Tai Boo
Yung is still reported to be engaged in illicit drug smuggling
and is reputed to be very rich.

During 1933/4 Tsounias was believed to have been
working together with a suspected Japanese smuggler named
Ide, residing at 52 Kung Wu Li, Quinsan Road. Ide is an
employee of the South Manchurian Railway, so the possibility
exists that Tsounias is now operating in Japanese made drugs.

The following are said to be friends and/or associates
of Tsounias:

Brothers Yannoulatos, No.120 Jinkee Road..suspected smugglers.
P.J. Klink, Netherlander, 3 Ezra Road (Office) and 100 Rue
Marcel Tillot (residence).

J. Ardavenias, Greek.

Serge Blutz, Russian Jew (? Latvian), whose brother is an
associate of drug smugglers in
Paris.

H.J. Kaimaziz, Greek, partner in Shanghai Supply Co.,
No.24 Broadway.

（左侧手写批注：E... / * A 6766）
（左侧手写批注：* Secale / D. 6207）
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

据悉，Tsounias 通过1928年10月15日由宝记洋行租用的邮政信箱第1511号接收信件，信件很可能以 Aldas 的名义寄送，由九江路24号22室中福公司（Chung Foo Co.）的 T.S. Yeh 先生担任担保人。后一家公司与前一家公司关系非常密切，在宝记洋行于1934年初停业后，所有寄给该公司的邮件均转送至中福公司。

戴步雲以前住在麦赫斯特路341弄12号，但现在住在江湾路他自己新建的住宅里。他曾受雇于中国海关，后来与 Tsounias 及前中欧贸易公司（China Europe Trading Coy.，博物馆路128号）发生关联，该公司由 N.L. Brandstatter 建立。据报道，戴步雲仍从事非法毒品走私，并以非常富有著称。

在1933/34年间，据信 Tsounias 曾与一名涉嫌日本走私犯 Ide 合作，Ide 居住在昆山路公吴里52号。Ide 是南满洲铁道株式会社的员工，因此存在 Tsounias 目前经营日本制造毒品的可能性。

以下是据说为 Tsounias 的朋友及/或同伙的人员：

Yannoulatos 兄弟，金尼路120号..涉嫌走私犯。
P.J. Klink，荷兰人，爱多亚路3号（办公室）及马塞尔·蒂洛路100号（住所）。

J. Ardavenias，希腊人。

Serge Blutz，俄籍犹太人（？拉脱维亚人），其兄弟是
巴黎毒品走私犯的同伙。

H.J. Kaimaziz，希腊人，百老汇路24号上海供应公司（Shanghai Supply Co.）合伙人。

（左侧手写批注：E... / * A 6766）
（左侧手写批注：* Secale / D. 6207）

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Vassili Tsounias, a brother of the Shanghai Tsounias,
resides at different times in various parts of Europe, such
as Istanbul, Paris, etc. and he is believed to be the
European agent of the ring for which John Tsounias acts
as the local head.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

Vassili Tsounias，上海 Tsounias 的兄弟，不时居住在欧洲各地，如伊斯坦布尔、巴黎等，据信他是该团伙的欧洲代理人，而 John Tsounias 则是该团伙的地方头目。

Subject (in full) Communication dated July 25, 1934 from H.B.M. Consulate-General regarding one ALDAS and his connections with the Drug Traffic.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [Signature] A.G.

Discreet and diligent enquiries over a lengthy period have established that ALDAS is identical with a Greek Janis TSUNIAS alias Yanis alias John TSOUNIAS, which latter name he invariably employs when conducting legitimate business.

A merchant by profession, Tsounias, who was born at Samos (Greece) on January 17, 1890, arrived in Shanghai from Europe some time in 1923. He has made various trips to Europe since that time and at present is a patient at the General Hospital convalescing from the effects of a recent operation.

In Shanghai Tsounias resides at No. 54 Wayside Road, cohabiting with a Mrs. P.G. Calavitis, in whose name the house and telephone are registered. This woman is the widow of the former notorious drug-smuggler Calavitis, who, until his death, was a partner in the Express Ricsha Company, No. 433 East Yuhang Road. Tsounias now acts as manager of this organisation, representing the interests of his paramour. With the exception of this Tsounias is not known to be engaged in any other business, apart from the smuggling of drugs, in which capacity he has been known for years. He appears as Serial No. 67 on the list of "Known and/or Suspected Criminals in Shanghai" as an arms and drug smuggler. He is believed to have been responsible for the smuggling of drugs from Japan and Europe into Shanghai, and was recently reported to have been engaged in importing drugs from Manchukuo for re-exportment to Europe and possibly the United States of America.

Tsounias is the owner of a Fiat motor-car, licence number 8839, which in 1926 he purchased from one Tai Boo Yung (戴步雲), who was the then manager of Boo Kee & Co., Importers, Exporters and Commission Agents, Room No. 10, No. 24 The Bund.

Wittinsky 的报告外，谨报告如下：I.Tsounias、他的兄弟和 A.C.Calavitis 夫人为我所知的麻醉品走私犯，是一个大型走私团伙的成员，该团伙包括其同伙在内约有20名成员。他们大多数是希腊国籍。其中 I.Tsounias 是首领之一。百老汇路7号的阿斯托里亚咖啡馆（Astoria "Cafe"）经常有 I.Tsounias 和其他可疑人物光顾，据信该咖啡馆是他们的大本营和走私犯的聚会地点。该咖啡馆的老板 K.Dimitriadis 及其兄弟被强烈怀疑是上述团伙的成员。根据可靠但未经证实的消息，上述咖啡馆及其他一些希腊人的店铺被走私犯用于储存麻醉品。

Sir,

ity, who cohabits with a man named I. Tsounias, well known as an

and has a brother who assists him in the smuggling of narcotics
to China.
It appears from enquiries that the brother of I. Tsounias
often visits Europe where he buys the heroine or morphine and
later ships same to Shanghai. Ioannis Tsounias disposes the said
cargo in Shanghai through a Chinese merchant, who is well known
to him (Tsounias).
In view of the fact that I. Tsounias is a very clever
narcotic smuggler it seems to be doubtful that he keeps any
narcotic in his house at 4 Wayside Road, but at the same time
it is quite possible that some samples of the cargo and shipping
documents relating to forwarding of the said cargo from Europe
to Shanghai may be found in his house.
The M/Car licence No. 8339 is the property of Mrs.
Calavitis, which was left to her by her deceased husband.
The attached are files on I. Tsounias and his former part-

J'ai l'honneur de vous signaler, à toutes fins utiles, deux sujets grecs, IOANNIS TSOUNIAS et PHOTIOS LERIOU, sur lesquels mon attention a été attirée par une dénonciation venue d'Alexandrie.

Après une enquête, j'ai appris que ces individus demeurent sur la Concession Internationale, au N° 17 Miller Road. Ce sont des trafiquants d'armes, qui vivent de cette contrebande, et n'ont pas de profession reconnue. Ils mènent une existence assez large.

D'après les renseignements déjà recueillis, ils vendent des armes par petites quantités à des bandits ou à des organisations politiques chinoises. Il y a quelques temps, ils fournissaient des armes aux sections communistes de combat de Shanghai.

Dans l'espoir que vous pourrez tirer profit de ces informations, je vous prie de croire, Cher Captain BARRETT, à mes meilleurs sentiments.
